info.description: Reusable header component with heading, description, and styling options

heading.description: Main heading text. When using two-tone style, this is the second part (non-accented)

headingAccent.description: Accented part of heading for two-tone style. This text appears first in theme color. Leave empty for default/gradient styles.

headingSize.description: Heading size: small (text-2xl/3xl), medium (text-3xl/4xl), large (text-4xl/5xl), xl (text-5xl/6xl)

textStyle.description: Optional text styling (gradient/two-tone) for heading. Leave empty for default solid color.

descriptionTextStyle.description: Optional text styling (gradient/two-tone) for description. Leave empty for default solid color.

alignment.description: Text alignment for heading and description

showDivider.description: Add decorative divider line below heading

showHeader.description: Toggle to show/hide the entire header section (heading + description)
